listing.description_html:
Make this Christmas extra merry with 40 adorable holiday coloring pages!

Kids ages 4 to 8 will love coloring Santa, his reindeer, jolly snowmen, busy elves, gingerbread friends and cozy winter scenes. Every page is designed with big, bold lines and simple shapes so little artists can color with confidence.

  • 40 unique illustrations full of holiday fun
  • Single sided pages so markers and crayons never bleed onto the next picture
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch format with plenty of space to color
  • Perfect gift for stockings, Advent calendars, class parties and long winter breaks

Screen free fun that builds focus, creativity and fine motor skills. Scroll up and add it to your cart today!
